core: Selective organelle autophagy and phagophore assembly
qualifier: pexophagy, nuclear microautophagy and nitrogen-starvation induction
name: Selective organelle autophagy with pexophagy and phagophore assembly
rationale: All members concern autophagosome formation or selective autophagy of organelles (peroxisome, mitochondria, nucleus) including ATG8 delipidation and nitrogen-starvation induction; pexophagy and positive phagophore assembly separate it from the aggrephagy/CMA, reticulophagy and PINK1-PRKN mitophagy neighbours.

core: CD4 T helper cell fate specification
qualifier: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell
name: IL-12-driven Th1 and regulatory T cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma output, suppression of Th2/Th17 fates and FOXP3 Treg development; the neighbours instead centre on IFN-gamma response, dendritic/NKT cells or T cell suppression and lack the Th1/Treg differentiation terms.

qualifier: G-CSF-driven, from myeloid progenitors, positive regulation
name: G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: All members describe commitment of myeloid progenitors to the granulocyte/neutrophil lineage and its G-CSF and retinoid drive; positive granulocyte differentiation and progenitor differentiation distinguish it from neighbours with negative regulation, eosinophil/mast cell, M-CSF or RUNX terms.

qualifier: PGC-1alpha/PPARA and circadian clock nuclear receptors
name: PGC-1alpha and clock nuclear receptor control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link PGC-1alpha/PPARA-driven mitochondrial biogenesis and fatty-acid response, ROR/REV-ERB/BMAL clock regulation, and gluconeogenesis, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation (nutrient-sensing) control; gluconeogenic and caloric-restriction terms separate it from circadian-output and lipid-homeostasis neighbours.

qualifier: G-CSF, M-CSF and GM-CSF receptor signaling in granulocyte and macrophage development
name: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in granulocyte and macrophage development
rationale: Members are G-CSF, M-CSF and GM-CSF receptor signaling with interleukin-receptor SHC signaling and the granulocyte and macrophage differentiation/proliferation they drive; receptor signaling (not CSF production, RUNX hematopoiesis or granule programmes) distinguishes it from the neighbours.

qualifier: RUNX-family transcriptional control, granulocyte/eosinophil/mast cell and progenitor stages
name: RUNX transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members span RUNX1/2/3- and VENTX-driven transcription with myeloid progenitor proliferation and differentiation into neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell lineages; RUNX targets and granulocytic stages distinguish it from erythroid-megakaryocyte, monocyte-macrophage and CSF-signaling neighbours.

core: Chromatin response at DNA double-strand breaks
qualifier: repair-dependent remodeling and NHEJ restraint
name: Chromatin remodeling and NHEJ restraint at double-strand breaks
rationale: All members concern protein recruitment, ADP-ribosylation-linked chromatin remodeling and negative control of end joining at double-strand breaks; neighbours either execute NHEJ/ATM sensing or address replication-coupled chromatin assembly.

qualifier: TLR2 recognition of bacterial lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
name: TLR2 sensing of bacterial lipopeptides and lipoteichoic acid
rationale: Members cover TLR signaling with TLR2 activation by diacyl lipopeptides, lipoteichoic acid and endogenous ligands in dendritic cells; the TLR2 ligand terms separate it from LPS/TLR4-CD14 and generic monocyte-inflammation neighbours.

qualifier: APP ectodomain shedding and synaptic plasticity impairment
name: Amyloid-beta production, accumulation and synaptic plasticity impairment
rationale: Members concern amyloid-beta generation via membrane protein ectodomain proteolysis, reduced clearance, cellular response to amyloid-beta and suppressed LTP; the neighbours instead emphasise microglial/astrocyte activation, tangles or amyloid clearance.

qualifier: sperm flagellum, dynein arms and central apparatus
name: Motile cilium and sperm flagellar axoneme assembly
rationale: All members build or deploy motile axonemes (dynein arms, central apparatus, sperm axoneme and manchette, mucociliary clearance); neighbours cover sperm mitochondria, tubulin modification, left-right asymmetry or basal-body multiciliogenesis.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly plus apoptotic nuclear dismantling
name: BAF chromatin remodeler assembly and apoptotic nuclear dismantling
rationale: Members fall into SWI/SNF BAF complex assembly variants and apoptotic DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown, united by large-scale chromatin reorganisation; the combination separates it from apoptosis-only and chromatin-assembly-only neighbours.

qualifier: FGFR3 and FGFR1 with positive and negative modulation
name: FGFR3 and FGFR1 signaling and its regulation
rationale: Members are FGFR3 and FGFR1 ligand binding, FRS/SHC adaptor cascades and oncogenic FGFR3 mutants together with Sprouty, FGFRL1 and GO positive/negative regulation of FGFR signaling; neighbours centre on FGFR2 or FGFR4/Klotho and lack the regulatory terms.

qualifier: BMP branch
name: BMP and TGF-beta SMAD signaling regulation
rationale: All members describe TGF-beta/BMP signaling through SMADs and its positive or negative regulation; the BMP and positive SMAD terms distinguish it from neighbours built on SMAD2/3 transcription, activin, cancer mutants or extracellular ligand sequestration.

qualifier: GPIb-IX-V binding, collagen and ADAMTS13 cleavage variants
name: Von Willebrand factor platelet adhesion and ADAMTS13 cleavage
rationale: Members cover VWF binding to collagen and GPIb-IX-V, platelet adhesion and activation, and VWF/GP1BA/ADAMTS13 variants; the GPIb-VWF axis separates it from basement-membrane, contact-activation and coagulation-cascade neighbours.

qualifier: ferredoxin electron transfer including steroidogenic use
name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and ferredoxin electron transfer
rationale: Members are [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, Fe-S-dependent TCA enzyme maturation and NADPH-ferredoxin electron transfer that also feeds pregnenolone synthesis; the ferredoxin/pregnenolone terms distinguish it from heme, ABC-transporter and respiratory-complex assembly neighbours.

qualifier: RNA processing, modification and ribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification and ribosome assembly
rationale: All members process or modify mitochondrial tRNA, rRNA and mRNA or assemble mitoribosomes for translation; neighbours focus on pseudouridylation, mitochondrial RNA decay or RNA import.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to PI3K-AKT and ERK
qualifier: MET/HGF, ERBB family and PTK6
name: MET, ERBB and PTK6 receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members are RTK and associated kinase signaling dominated by MET/HGF, EGFR/ERBB2-4 and PTK6 events feeding PI3K-AKT, ERK and STAT3; these receptors distinguish it from FGFR/RAS-MAPK, EGFR-endocytic downregulation and EPO/IGF1R neighbours.

qualifier: initiation and unwinding in the mitotic cell cycle
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and unwinding
rationale: Members concern origin unwinding, replication initiation and polymerase activity in mitotic S phase, including break-induced replication and E2F1 targets; neighbours instead carry replication-stress checkpoints or broader E2F cell-cycle modules.

qualifier: structural plasticity and dendritic spine maturation
name: Structural synaptic plasticity and dendritic spine maturation
rationale: Members promote long-term and structural synaptic plasticity, spine morphogenesis, synapse maturation and local synaptic translation; neighbours emphasise postsynaptic actin/dendrite arborisation, LTP/LTD calcium and memory, or CREB/NPAS4 transcription.

qualifier: trabecular bone, tendon and proteoglycan synthesis
name: Osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in trabecular bone and tendon
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in both directions alongside trabecula formation, tendon development and proteoglycan biosynthesis; the tendon/trabecula/proteoglycan terms separate it from mineralisation, Wnt-MSC and cranial ossification neighbours.

qualifier: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and abscission
name: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope resealing and abscission at mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover late-mitotic membrane events, ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and disassembly, midbody abscission, cytokinesis restraint and endoreduplication; neighbours instead hold contractile ring, spindle, cohesion and chromosome condensation terms.

qualifier: tyrosine degradation
name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine/phenylalanine breakdown plus generic amino acid catabolic parent terms; tyrosine degradation distinguishes it from glycine/glyoxylate, threonine and histidine catabolism neighbours, while the phenylketonuria neighbour lacks the tyrosine-catabolic emphasis.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD+ metabolism
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and NAD+ cofactor metabolism
rationale: Members cover PDH conversion of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA, pantothenate/CoA synthesis and nicotinate/NAD(P)+ synthesis, salvage, transport and turnover; the NAD+/nicotinate terms distinguish it from thiamine/riboflavin, OGDH/lipoylation and TCA-cycle neighbours.

core: Regulation of sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium release
qualifier: ryanodine receptor restraint in skeletal muscle
name: Restraint of ryanodine receptor calcium release in skeletal muscle
rationale: All members limit or regulate release of stored calcium via ryanodine-sensitive channels and its effect on skeletal muscle contraction; neighbours instead cover store-operated entry, SERCA/calcium pumping or cardiac contraction.

qualifier: SLCO-mediated drug ADME and bilirubin (Rotor syndrome)
name: SLCO-mediated organic anion uptake of drugs and bilirubin
rationale: Members are sodium-independent SLCO organic anion transport, drug ADME of statin, aspirin, prednisone and ciprofloxacin and SLCO1B1/1B3 Rotor hyperbilirubinemia; SLCO specificity and bilirubin defects separate it from SLC22/cation transport, xenobiotic metabolism and UGT/ABCC2 bilirubin neighbours.
